review.hook_bounds: The low-level hook only reduces and queues a fenced action; Explorer and Shell work runs on a named worker.
review.broker_security: Explorer launch and shutdown reuse signed canonical inbox resolution, current-session validation, and exact process identity checks.
review.ownership: Only a broker started because Explorer was absent is cleaned up; a pre-existing Explorer shell is never request-owned.
review.activation: A ready verified Shell_TrayWnd precedes the exact fixed native hotkey URI; no Snipping Tool path is discovered in production.
review.errors: Every launch, readiness, activation, overlay, timeout, and cleanup failure becomes a scoped console error without panic.
review.privacy: Both physical reports contain zero screen-content artifacts.
review.regressions: Full workspace tests, Clippy -D warnings, two physical runs, release, and installer provenance passed.
review.unrelated_changes: Pre-existing untracked evidence was preserved and restored; parent staged only SuperDesktop.
